cohort: 260 women receiving medication assisted treatment with methadone or buprenorphine
finding: Medication assisted treatment with buprenorphine, compared to methadone, was associated with increased birthweight, reduced need for newborn treatment, and shorter newborn length of stay in term infants.
birth_weight: Methadone group: 2874±459 g, Buprenorphine group: 3282±452 g
